cards.back:
To leave your bed after you wake.
Bahasa Indonesia: bangun dari tempat tidur
Example: I get up at six o'clock every day.
cards.say: get up. To leave your bed after you wake. I get up at six o'clock every day.

cards.back:
To stop sleeping.
Bahasa Indonesia: bangun (dari tidur)
Example: The alarm clock made me wake up.
cards.say: wake up. To stop sleeping. The alarm clock made me wake up.

cards.back:
To dress yourself in clothes.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengenakan
Example: Put on your coat because it is cold.
cards.say: put on. To dress yourself in clothes. Put on your coat because it is cold.

cards.back:
To remove clothes from your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: melepas
Example: Take off your shoes at the door.
cards.say: take off. To remove clothes from your body. Take off your shoes at the door.

cards.back:
To make a machine or light start working.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyalakan
Example: Please turn on the light in the hall.
cards.say: turn on. To make a machine or light start working. Please turn on the light in the hall.

cards.back:
To make a machine or light stop working.
Bahasa Indonesia: mematikan
Example: Turn off the television before bed.
cards.say: turn off. To make a machine or light stop working. Turn off the television before bed.

cards.back:
To try to find something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencari
Example: I am looking for my red pencil.
cards.say: look for. To try to find something. I am looking for my red pencil.

cards.back:
To take care of someone or something.
Bahasa Indonesia: merawat
Example: I look after my little brother after school.
cards.say: look after. To take care of someone or something. I look after my little brother after school.

cards.back:
To lift something from a surface.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengambil, memungut
Example: Pick up your toys and put them away.
cards.say: pick up. To lift something from a surface. Pick up your toys and put them away.

cards.back:
To put something in its right place.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyimpan
Example: Put away your books when you finish.
cards.say: put away. To put something in its right place. Put away your books when you finish.

cards.back:
To move your body to a seat.
Bahasa Indonesia: duduk
Example: Please sit down and open your books.
cards.say: sit down. To move your body to a seat. Please sit down and open your books.

cards.back:
To rise onto your feet.
Bahasa Indonesia: berdiri
Example: The class stand up when the teacher comes in.
cards.say: stand up. To rise onto your feet. The class stand up when the teacher comes in.

cards.back:
To return to a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: kembali
Example: Please come back before it gets dark.
cards.say: come back. To return to a place. Please come back before it gets dark.

cards.back:
To leave the house to do something.
Bahasa Indonesia: keluar rumah
Example: We go out to the park on Sundays.
cards.say: go out. To leave the house to do something. We go out to the park on Sundays.

cards.back:
To return something to its owner.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengembalikan
Example: Please give back my pen when you finish.
cards.say: give back. To return something to its owner. Please give back my pen when you finish.

cards.back:
To put something in the bin.
Bahasa Indonesia: membuang
Example: Throw away the empty bottle, please.
cards.say: throw away. To put something in the bin. Throw away the empty bottle, please.

cards.back:
To catch your foot on something and fall or nearly fall.
Bahasa Indonesia: tersandung
Example: The little boy tripped over a stone in the mud.
cards.say: trip over. To catch your foot on something and fall or nearly fall. The little boy tripped over a stone in the mud.

cards.back:
To go or act faster.
Bahasa Indonesia: bergegas
Example: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
cards.say: hurry up. To go or act faster. Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.

cards.back:
To become happier.
Bahasa Indonesia: ceria kembali
Example: Cheer up, we can try again tomorrow.
cards.say: cheer up. To become happier. Cheer up, we can try again tomorrow.

cards.back:
To make a place tidy and clean.
Bahasa Indonesia: membereskan, membersihkan
Example: We clean up the classroom every Friday.
cards.say: clean up. To make a place tidy and clean. We clean up the classroom every Friday.

cards.back:
To put words on paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: menuliskan, mencatat
Example: Write down the answer in your book.
cards.say: write down. To put words on paper. Write down the answer in your book.

cards.back:
To put on clothes to see if they fit.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencoba (pakaian)
Example: She tried on three dresses in the shop.
cards.say: try on. To put on clothes to see if they fit. She tried on three dresses in the shop.

cards.back:
To learn something that you did not know.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencari tahu, mengetahui
Example: I want to find out how bees make honey.
cards.say: find out. To learn something that you did not know. I want to find out how bees make honey.
